offense_title_full: Purposely or Knowingly Causes Reasonable Apprehension of Bodily Injury in the Sports Official
offense_title_short: Purposely/Knowingly Causes Reasonable Apprehension of Bodily Injury
offense_display_full: Assault Upon Sports Official - Purposely or Knowingly Causes Reasonable Apprehension of Bodily Injury in the Sports Official
offense_display_short: Assault - Sports Official - Purposely/Knowingly Causes Reasonable Apprehension of Bodily Injury
description: A person commits the offense of assault upon a sports official if, while a sports official is acting as an official at an athletic contest in any sport at any level of amateur or professional competition, the person purposely or knowingly causes reasonable apprehension of bodily injury in the sports official.
